## The question

[Tikz node: color change when the mouse is hovering](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/10050/tikz-node-color-change-when-the-mouse-is-hovering), asked by [Arianna Angeletti](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/2312/arianna-angeletti) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-02-01; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> Is it possible to get a change of Tikz node colors when the mouse is hovering on it?
>
> Thanks in advance!
:::

You might try something with the [`fancytooltips`](http://ctan.org/pkg/fancytooltips) package.  That's probably not what exactly what you want, but maybe if the tooltip was a copy of the image with the color changed it could work.
